<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<LinearLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto"
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="match_parent"
    android:orientation="vertical"
    android:background="#121212">

    <LinearLayout
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:orientation="horizontal"
        android:padding="16dp"
        android:gravity="center_vertical">

        <TextView
            android:id="@+id/btnBack"
            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:text="←"
            android:textSize="24sp"
            android:textColor="#FFFFFF"
            android:padding="8dp"
            android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless"
            android:clickable="true"
            android:focusable="true" />

        <TextView
            android:layout_width="0dp"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_weight="1"
            android:text="Създаване На Писта"
            android:textSize="24sp"
            android:textColor="#FFFFFF"
            android:textStyle="bold"
            android:gravity="center" />
    </LinearLayout>

    <LinearLayout
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="0dp"
        android:layout_weight="1"
        android:orientation="vertical"
        android:padding="32dp"
        android:gravity="center">

        <androidx.cardview.widget.CardView
            android:id="@+id/btnPhoneMode"
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_marginBottom="24dp"
            app:cardCornerRadius="12dp"
            app:cardElevation="4dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="#2C2C2C"
            android:clickable="true"
            android:focusable="true">

            <LinearLayout
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:orientation="vertical"
                android:padding="24dp">

                <TextView
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:text="От Телефона"
                    android:textSize="20sp"
                    android:textColor="#FFFFFF"
                    android:textStyle="bold"
                    android:layout_marginBottom="10dp" />

                <TextView
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:text="Ръчно поставяне и редакция на линии и checkpoints върху картата."
                    android:textSize="13sp"
                    android:textColor="#B8B8B8" />
            </LinearLayout>
        </androidx.cardview.widget.CardView>

        <androidx.cardview.widget.CardView
            android:id="@+id/btnDrivingMode"
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            app:cardCornerRadius="12dp"
            app:cardElevation="4dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="#2C2C2C"
            android:clickable="true"
            android:focusable="true">

            <LinearLayout
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:orientation="vertical"
                android:padding="24dp">

                <TextView
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:text="С Каране"
                    android:textSize="20sp"
                    android:textColor="#FFFFFF"
                    android:textStyle="bold"
                    android:layout_marginBottom="10dp" />

                <TextView
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:text="GPS запис на траекторията и автоматично генериране на checkpoints."
                    android:textSize="13sp"
                    android:textColor="#B8B8B8" />
            </LinearLayout>
        </androidx.cardview.widget.CardView>
    </LinearLayout>

</LinearLayout>
